complete_source_units.text: All Judah stood before the Lord, with their children and the women.
He built towers in the wilderness and hewed many cisterns, because he had many herds in Sephela and the plain, and vinedressers in the hill country and Carmel, for he loved farming.
King Hezekiah rose early, gathered the city’s rulers, and went up to the Lord’s house.
Many brought gifts to the Lord at Jerusalem and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, and afterward he was highly exalted in the eyes of all the nations.
and cities for the produce of grain, oil, and wine, mangers for every animal, and folds for the flocks,

After these things he built a wall outside the City of David, from the southwest opposite Gihon in the winter stream, and where people go out through the surrounding gate, and toward Ophla, and raised it very high. He stationed commanders of the force in all Judah’s walled cities.
